quote: the pre-command policy check could not run, so the command was blocked
reason: Fail-closed operation of the pre-command gates (any internal error denies the shell command); a property of the gates already captured in their modality, not a separate engineering-outcome rule.

quote: Run the `add-dependency` workflow first
reason: Suspected EXTRA (mandatory workflow + self-certifying marker before every dependency command). Kept oracle-linked for additions/updates: DEP-003..DEP-005 require registry verification, due diligence and license approval before installation, which is what the workflow gate enforces; the marker is the gate's mechanism. Removals are registered separately as EXTRA-K0-0001.
specific_behavior: Dependency additions/updates are blocked until the agent declares the review complete.

quote: Git: table-driven read-only vs repository-changing classification
reason: Suspected EXTRA because the permission prompt also covers git add/fetch/pull/checkout. Kept oracle-linked: GOV-015 covers 'other repository-changing Git operations' and the prompt only asks for confirmation instead of forbidding them.
specific_behavior: Every repository-changing git command raises a permission prompt.

quote: update every reference to it
reason: Suspected EXTRA maintenance duty. Kept oracle-linked: a moved project/manifest left unreferenced breaks the build that WF-005 requires to pass; the message adds no outcome restriction.
specific_behavior: References to a moved project must be updated.

quote: Production code changed without test changes
reason: The reminder also covers frontend .ts files although oracle TST policies are scoped to backend tests. Kept oracle-linked: it only asks to confirm coverage or add tests (stack-neutral TST-009/TST-010 wording) and allows finishing after confirmation.
specific_behavior: Stop is blocked once when production code changed without test changes.

quote: if (kind === 'change' || (kind === 'spec' && rest.length > 0)
reason: The oracle's dependency policies (DEP-001..DEP-005) govern additions and updates; no oracle policy subjects dependency removal to a review workflow or approval confirmation.
specific_behavior: `npm uninstall lodash` is denied until the add-dependency removal checklist was run and the marker is added.

quote: dotnet add/remove [<project>] package|reference
reason: ARC-001 already permits inward references and ARC-020 gates consequential changes such as new projects/layers; no oracle policy makes every legal reference edge a Reserved decision.
specific_behavior: Adding the standard Api -> Application reference is denied until a Decision Request is approved and the marker is added.

reason: Suspected EXTRA. Kept oracle-linked: wall-clock dependence makes tests non-deterministic (TST-004) and RUN-004 names TimeProvider for deterministic time.

quote: Conformance dependencies point WF → KNW → STD → DEC → OP, and ENF → STD/DEC; enforcement declares its conformance in its header and in `Conforms to:` comment lines. Routing pointers may point anywhere reliably invocable: references after `See also:`, `Workflow:`, `Technique:`, `Procedure:` or `Enforced by:`, workflow invocations (run, use, invoke, switch to, `→`, slash commands, agent delegation), the `CLAUDE.md` routing table, and the register's **Details in** / **Affects** cells. Every other reference is a conformance dependency, checked for direction and acyclicity by `check-instructions.cjs`; references to product inputs and enforcement files name inputs and tools, not owners. A skill's `references/` files are read only by that skill. Standards cite decision IDs instead of restating decisions; decision summaries exist only in the register.
reason: Internal reference discipline of the instruction system; no oracle policy governs how instruction files reference each other or where decision summaries may appear.
specific_behavior: A standard that restates a register decision instead of citing its D-xx ID, or a backward reference, is a structural error.

quote: Mechanism and location
reason: Template maintenance rule (single owner per topic, map synchronized with the register); not a V2 policy.
specific_behavior: Adding an artifact or changing a decision's Affects without updating MAP.md is a structural error.

quote: including mapping-library concerns
reason: ARC-002 lists EF Core, ASP.NET Core, HTTP, persistence and external-service implementation concerns; mapping-library independence of Domain is an additional restriction (DEP-011 only governs when Mapster is approved).
specific_behavior: A Domain type using Mapster configuration or attributes violates the standard.

quote: do not convert constructors mechanically
reason: RUN-009 delegates conventions to the repository and .editorconfig and RUN-024 covers only namespaces, one type per file and Async naming; the oracle classifies constructor/record/visibility/type-inference preferences as non-oracle style (EXC-003). The naming and var parts mirror .editorconfig (a RUN-009 convention source), but the visibility, sealed, record and primary-constructor preferences have no .editorconfig or oracle counterpart, so the loaded standard adds style constraints the 196 do not contain.
specific_behavior: New code is expected to use primary constructors for simple injection, internal visibility by default and var for obvious types.

quote: Commit `package.json` and `package-lock.json`
reason: Open question: read literally, the standard instructs a git commit of the manifests, which GOV-015 permits only on explicit request; read as 'keep them under version control', it restates DEP-007. The imperative wording does not settle which.
specific_behavior: Under the literal reading the agent would commit manifests after dependency changes without a Git request.

quote: commit a consistent lockfile
reason: The notice says 'commit' a lockfile; recorded as oracle-linked lockfile consistency (DEP-007). The Git meaning of 'commit' is tracked as UNCERTAIN-K0-0001.
specific_behavior: Missing lockfile produces a notice.

reason: GOV-017 requires approval of Reserved changes but no Affects-driven propagation procedure across instruction artifacts.

reason: GOV-015 allows history-changing operations on explicit request; declaring main/master non-rewritable is a stricter, unconditional restriction.

specific_behavior: Under the broad reading a workflow could reset or force-push without a specific user request.

quote: Do not wrap normal EF Core operations in a generic application-level retry pipeline. reason: RUN-016 limits retries to safe operations and DEP-020 sets resilience package defaults; no oracle policy forbids application-level retry pipelines around database calls or prescribes provider execution strategies (the oracle treats database-retry examples as technique, EXC-007).
specific_behavior: A resilience pipeline wrapped around repository calls is prohibited.

quote: mutating shared `DefaultRequestHeaders` concurrently for request-specific values is a race

specific_behavior: Setting a per-user Authorization header on a shared client's DefaultRequestHeaders is treated as a defect.
